rows.employees_note: INDONESIAN STAFF ONLY, AND A FLOOR. LinkedIn lists 65 people on Rumah123's own company page ("Lihat seluruh 65 karyawan"), read 18 Oct 2026. It is the right page: it links to rumah123.com, gives Jakarta as its headquarters and Level 37, EightyEight@Kasablanka, Tebet, Jakarta Selatan as its primary location, the same address as both Indonesian companies in the register. Its self-declared size band is 201-500, well above the count. The real Indonesian team is larger than 65: the group hires its Indonesian staff under the 99 Group name (its 2026 posts recruit for its Jakarta and Bandung offices, and its July 2026 internship call places interns at PT Web Marketing Indonesia), many of them list 99 Group rather than Rumah123 as their employer, and Rumah123 also lists offices in Bandung, Surabaya, Medan, Yogyakarta and Bali. 99 Group's own page (617 people on 18 Oct 2026, headquartered in Singapore) mixes Indonesian and Singapore staff with no country split, so it cannot be used as an Indonesian figure. An older LinkedIn page under the legal name PT Web Marketing Indonesia lists 52 people but has no posts and carries out-of-date profiles, so it is not used either. No LinkedIn page for 99.co Indonesia alone and no dated company statement of the Indonesian headcount were found. 99 Group's About page says the group as a whole has more than 500 employees, with no date and no country split.
rows.funding_note: Not an Indonesian figure, so none is published. The money was raised by 99 Group, the Singapore parent: a Series C led by Gaw Capital Partners in July 2022, reported at US$52M by the Business Times and announced in Gaw Capital's own release, and a US$11M extension of that round in March 2023 (Business Times). Endeavor's profile of the group's co-founder and CEO, Darius Cheung, says the group has raised over US$80M in total. Rumah123 came into the group through a joint venture with REA Group announced in October 2019, in which 99.co took over REA's Indonesian and Singapore portals, 99.co's shareholders held 73% and REA Group put in US$8M of working capital (REA Group release; TechCrunch; Business Times). The Indonesian companies have raised nothing of their own.
rows.last_round: Series C extension (US$11M) — at group level
rows.valuation_note: No current figure. 99 Group is private and unlisted and reports nothing by country. The last figure on record predates the Rumah123 deal: in October 2019 TechCrunch reported 99.co's statement that its US$15.2M Series B, announced that August, had taken its valuation to over US$100M.
rows.verify_note: Test 1 (venture-built): this is the Indonesian business of 99 Group, the Singapore property-portal group that Darius Cheung, Yan Phun and Conor McLaughlin launched in 2014 (99 Group's About page), backed by venture and private-equity money (Gaw Capital Partners led its 2022 Series C). In Indonesia it runs two portals, Rumah123.com and 99.co/id, which sell listings and advertising to developers, agents and owners. Rumah123 itself began in 2007, founded by Sandiaga Uno through Saratoga Group; it passed to iProperty Group in 2011 and later to REA Group (Rumah123's About page), and 99.co took over its operation in the joint venture with REA Group announced in October 2019. Census unit: one row for both Indonesian companies rather than Rumah123 alone, because the group runs them as one Indonesian business: Darius Cheung is both group CEO and CEO Indonesia (About page), both companies are registered at the same Jakarta office, and the group hires for both brands under the 99 Group name, placing its 2026 MagangHub interns at PT Web Marketing Indonesia and advertising job-board vacancies under PT Ninety Nine Dotco (Jobstreet). A separate 99.co Indonesia row would count the same business twice. Test 2 (own entity): Rumah123.com's advertiser terms say the site is operated by PT Web Marketing Indonesia, and its footer reads "Rumah123 (PT Web Marketing Indonesia) merupakan bagian dari 99 Group"; ANTARA reported on 18 Jun 2026 that Bank Tabungan Negara had signed a cooperation agreement with "PT Web Marketing Indonesia (Rumah123)" the day before. 99.co/id's terms for property advertisers name PT Ninety Nine Dotco. Both are in the Ministry of Law and Human Rights company register (registration numbers 144607 and 752345, as shown by companieshouse.id), registered at Level 37, EightyEight@Kasablanka, Jl. Casablanca Kav. 88, Jakarta Selatan. Test 3 (headcount): LinkedIn shows 65 people on Rumah123's own page on 18 Oct 2026, against a self-declared band of 201-500; it is a floor, as the employees note explains. Geography: head office at Level 37, EightyEight@Kasablanka, Jl. Casablanca Kav. 88, Menteng Dalam, Tebet, Jakarta Selatan 12870 (Rumah123's LinkedIn page, its contact page and the register); Rumah123's contact page also lists offices in Bandung, Surabaya, Medan, Yogyakarta and Bali. The parent is headquartered in Singapore, where it also runs 99.co and SRX. Liveness: rumah123.com answered on 18 Oct 2026; the Rumah123 app, published by 99 Pte. Ltd., was updated on the App Store on 12 Oct 2026; Rumah123's LinkedIn page posted its October 2026 flash report on 15 Oct 2026 and marked the group's 12th year on 9 Sep 2026; the group's page advertised account-executive openings in Jakarta on 5 Jun 2026 and six-month internships under the Ministry of Manpower's MagangHub programme on 19 Jul 2026. Doubtful: the headcount understates the Indonesian team. Namesakes: not to be confused with Rumah.com, a different portal whose Indonesian operation 99 Group said in August 2023 was due to close on 30 Nov 2023.

rows.funding_note: One round: US$11.3 million of strategic investment from private and institutional investors, first reported by DealStreetAsia on 3 Jun 2026, which called it FLOQ's first external funding round, and announced in FLOQ's own release of 7 Jun 2026 (also Tech in Asia, 4 Jun 2026; detikFinance, 8 Jun 2026). FLOQ's release names Ascent, Sharpbyte, HFX Group and MD Capital among the investors; several reports print 'Ascent' and 'HFX Group' as one name, 'Ascent HFX Group', and the list here follows the release. The announcements call the money an investment and new capital, none describes it as a loan, and neither the instrument nor a valuation was disclosed. Kompas (25 Jun 2026) put it at about Rp202.8 billion at Rp17,943 per US dollar. rows.verify_note: Test 1 (venture-built): FLOQ is led by its founder and CEO Yudhono Rawis, a former CEO of Tokocrypto and former partner and head of M&A at KPMG Indonesia (FLOQ's own site; detikFinance, 8 Jun 2026). Techverse (8 Jun 2026) and Investortrust (18 Apr 2025) also name the crypto educators Timothy Ronald and Kalimasada as co-founders, and Timothy Ronald's own LinkedIn profile calls him a co-owner since April 2025. It raised US$11.3 million from outside investors in June 2026. The licence-holding company, PT Kripto Maksima Koin, was bought by GoTo in August 2022 (100% for Rp124.83 billion, mostly through its subsidiary PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa). GoTo's audited statements for 2024 record that GoTo lost control of it in October 2024 after disposing of part of its interest, stopped consolidating it and its new Singapore parent, Kripto Maksima Holding Pte. Ltd., and kept the rest, an effective 67.96% at 31 Dec 2024, as an associate. GoTo's statements for 2025 name only Tokopedia and Bank Jago among its associates and group the rest without names, so whether GoTo still holds that stake is not disclosed. GoTo's 2024 annual report listed its then director Pablo Malay as a commissioner of PT Kripto Maksima Koin and a director of the Singapore parent (Investortrust, 3 Jun 2025); the board now printed on FLOQ's site (directors Yudhono Rawis, Suryo Adipradono and Eveline Shinta; commissioner Salomo Jhuan Anggara) includes no member of GoTo's board. Because GoTo neither controls nor consolidates it, it is not counted inside the census's GoTo row. Test 2 (own entity): PT Kripto Maksima Koin (FLOQ) is on OJK's list of licensed digital financial asset traders (licence S-21/D.07/2025, 1 Feb 2025; list as of May 2026); the site footer reads "2026 PT Kripto Maksima Koin" and the App Store lists the company as the seller of the FLOQ app. The company register (companieshouse.id, number 1201272, incorporated 7 Oct 2021) and the app's Google Play developer details still show the GoTo-era address at Pasaraya Blok M. Test 3 (headcount): LinkedIn shows 70 people on 18 Oct 2026, band 51-200. Geography: the company-information section of FLOQ's terms page gives the office as Jl. Kebayoran Baru No. 73B & 73C, Kebayoran Lama Utara, Kebayoran Lama, Jakarta Selatan; its LinkedIn page gives South Tangerang. The Equity Tower address in SCBD shown on FLOQ's page at the clearing house CACI is CACI's own office. Liveness: floq.co.id answered on 18 Oct 2026 and the App Store app was updated on 14 Oct 2026; FLOQ reported more than 1.8 million registered users and 100 listed tokens at the end of the first quarter of 2026 (detikFinance, 1 Apr 2026), announced its round in June, spoke at CoinFest Asia in August and at BINUS Crypto Week on 25-26 Sep 2026 (its own blog, 28 Sep 2026), and posted on its LinkedIn page on 16 Oct 2026. Doubtful: the present shareholders, GoTo's remaining stake if any, and the terms on which the current owners took control from GoTo have not been published. The founding year 2025 is when the FLOQ business started (work on the platform began in January 2025 and the app launched publicly on 30 May 2025); the company itself was incorporated in October 2021 and registered with the commodity-futures regulator as a prospective crypto trader in January 2022. Namesakes: Floq is also the name of unrelated software and design firms abroad; the Indonesian exchange uses floq.co.id and floq.id.

rejected_record.name: Lighthouse Indonesia (LIGHThouse Clinic)

LIGHThouse is a medically supervised weight-control clinic chain built by its founder and CEO, Dr Grace Judio-Kahl, from the private practice she opened in 2004; it is run by PT Shape Up Indonesia, part of her LIGHT Group (head office Wisma MRA, 12th floor, Jl. TB Simatupang No. 19, Cilandak, Jakarta Selatan). Its only reported outside money is debt: DealStreetAsia (16 Apr 2026) reported that the company "has secured debt funding and is preparing for a larger equity fundraising". No equity investor, venture fund, angel or accelerator is on record, and LIGHT Group's own investor page only invites partnership enquiries. The census counts a clinic chain only when tech or venture money built or bought it; a founder-funded chain with a loan does not pass. Revisit if the planned equity round closes and is announced. For the record: the business is alive (LIGHT Group releases dated 14 Jan, 20 Feb and 10 Jun 2026; site copyright 2026), LinkedIn's LIGHT Group page lists 56 people (band 201-500) on 18 Oct 2026, and Endeavor Indonesia lists Lighthouse Indonesia among its entrepreneur companies. Namesake: the LinkedIn page at /company/lighthouse-indonesia belongs to 3Lighthouses, an unrelated hospitality and human-capital firm.

rejected_record.name: ONIC Esports
rejected_record.why: Fails test 1: ONIC Esports, the Jakarta esports organisation founded in July 2018 by Rob Clinton Kardinal with Justin Widjaja, now its CEO, is controlled by a mining and shipping group. IDN Times (3 Sep 2026) reports that Rob Clinton Kardinal gave up his ownership in 2019 and that ONIC now sits under PT Daidan Aditama Yaksa, a company in mining and shipping. Daidan's own job-board profile describes DAIDAN GROUP as working in "mining, shipping for mining, e-sports, and talent management" (Jobstreet), Universitas Trisakti's career centre describes PT Daidan Aditama Yaksa as a mining and shipping company (5 Apr 2023), and the company holds a coal transport-and-sale mining licence (IUP OPK). ONIC did take venture money early on: Agaeti Venture Capital invested in 2019 (Hybrid.co.id, 18 Aug 2019) and Skystar Capital lists ONIC in its portfolio, with no amounts published. As with Mbiz, a Lippo affiliate that also took a venture round, a company controlled by an incumbent group is outside the census even with venture investors on its register. ONIC has its own company, PT Onic Esport Indonesia (AHU business number 1237436, registered at The Boulevard Office, Jl. Fachrudin No. 5, Jakarta Pusat); the group's control of it is reported by the press and by the group's own profile, not shown by a registry extract. For the record: the team is active, and LinkedIn's ONIC Esports page lists 124 people (band 51-200) on 18 Oct 2026. Revisit if a registry extract shows that the Daidan group does not control PT Onic Esport Indonesia.

Revisit only if the group spins it out with outside investors.

rejected_record.name: Fairbanc (PT Fairbanc Technologies Indonesia)
rejected_record.why: Fails the liveness test on 18 Oct 2026, although no source confirms that it has closed, so it is not entered in the closed register either. Its website fairbanc.app does not answer properly: over HTTPS it presents a self-signed certificate, and over HTTP it returns a WordPress 'critical error' page (HTTP 500), read 18 Oct 2026; the dashboard and e-commerce subdomains it used before no longer resolve. The last operating signals found are from late 2025: founder and CEO Mir Haque wrote on LinkedIn that Amar Bank had become the 13th bank to sign a partnership with Fairbanc that year (5 Nov 2025) and announced a working-capital partnership with the procurement platform Pengadaan (18 Dec 2025); AFTECH's member directory still lists PT Fairbanc Technologies Indonesia, with a membership active date of 15 Oct 2025 and a membership update date of 15 Oct 2026; a directory entry is not evidence that the business is trading. No 2026 operating signal was found: no 2026 news, company posts, app listing or job posts. The LinkedIn company page still shows 25 people and a San Francisco head office (read 18 Oct 2026), but its public view shows no recent posts. Tracker context only: PitchBook marks it out of business, and Vertex Ventures, an early investor, lists it among its exits; neither gives a date or a reason, and no press report of a closure was found. For the record, the other tests looked passable: venture-backed (a US$4.8M pre-Series A led by Vertex Ventures SEA in 2022; later money was debt, including US$13.3M from Pegadaian's digital-lending arm in 2024, a Rp50 billion loan from Bahana Artha Ventura in Dec 2024 and a credit facility from CIMB Niaga in Feb 2025), and PT Fairbanc Technologies Indonesia is registered at South Quarter Tower A, Lt. 18, Jl. R.A. Kartini Kav. 8, Cilandak Barat, Jakarta Selatan. Revisit if the site comes back or a 2026 operating signal appears; enter it in the closed register if a closure is reported.

rejected_record.name: Confiction Labs (RIFTSTORM; formerly Mythic Protocol)
rejected_record.why: Fails test 2 and the geography test, and its Indonesian work is already counted under Agate. The only legal entity is the Singapore company Mythic Alliance Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202214971K, incorporated 29 Apr 2022, registered at 3 Fraser Street, Duo Tower, Singapore), named in the confiction.com footer ('© 2024 Mythic Alliance, Pte. Ltd.'); its privacy policy gives no Indonesian entity or address, and no Indonesian PT for Confiction or Mythic Protocol was found in the company register. Its LinkedIn page gives Singapore as the head office (30 people, band 51-200, read 18 Oct 2026). The Indonesian development team belongs to Agate, which is already a census row: Agate's own release (Bandung, 11 Jun 2025) says it launched RIFTSTORM, 'co-developed with Confiction Labs', with more than 120 local talents and the work 'carried out entirely in-house', and Kompas (12 Jun 2025) reports that Agate developed the game with 120 local workers; Mythic Protocol job openings were advertised by PT Agate International (ITB Career Center). Steam lists Confiction Labs and Agate as developers and Confiction Labs and Gamersky Games as publishers; the game entered Early Access on 11 Aug 2026. Confiction's CEO, Arief Widhiyasa, co-founded Agate. A row for Confiction would therefore count a Singapore IP and publishing company whose Indonesian developers work for Agate. For the record: the company raised a US$6.5M seed round in Sep 2023 co-led by Shima Capital and Alpha JWC Ventures (company release on PR Newswire, 12 Sep 2023), and on 9 Jul 2026 it wrote that it was realigning its 'scant few remaining resources' to game development and dropping its web3 work. Revisit only if an Indonesian PT with its own staff and office appears.

rejected_record.name: Target Media Nusantara (TMN)
rejected_record.why: Fails test 1: TMN is the Indonesian branch of a listed Chinese media incumbent, not a venture-built tech company. Its own site says 'Target Media Nusantara (TMN) is the branch office of China Focus Media Group in Indonesia', and its LinkedIn page is titled 'Target Media Nusantara | Focus Media Group' and calls it 'the Indonesian branch of China Focus Media Group'. Focus Media Information Technology Co., Ltd. has been listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange since 2004 (code 002027); TMN's About page presents it as one of the group's country operations alongside Focus Media Korea, Japan, Vietnam and India and Target Media Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand and Malaysia. The business sells advertising airtime on screens in the lifts and lobbies of office and apartment buildings (7,250+ screens claimed): a media network built by a foreign incumbent expanding abroad, the same shape as earlier exclusions of foreign groups' local arms. Alpha JWC Ventures put an undisclosed Series A into TMN in 2018 (DealStreetAsia, 15 Nov 2018; Alpha JWC release, 30 Nov 2018, which also calls TMN 'a member of China-based Focus Media Group'); that undisclosed investment does not change who built and runs the business: Focus Media Group, which the About page dates to 2003. For the record, it is operating: hellotmn.com answered on 18 Oct 2026 with blog posts dated September and October 2026, the site footer names PT Target Media Nusantara, and LinkedIn lists 85 people with a Jakarta head office (read 18 Oct 2026).

rejected_record.name: Youtap (Youtap Indonesia)
rejected_record.why: Fails test 1: Youtap Indonesia belongs to an incumbent conglomerate. Its own About page says it is part of the Salim Group ('Sebagai bagian dari Salim Group yang resmi beroperasi pada Februari 2020'), and its FAQ names the operating company as PT Mitra Digital Sukses, domiciled in DKI Jakarta. It sells a point-of-sale cashier app with QRIS payments to small and large merchants and is operating (Youtap POS on Google Play, a pricing page and Jakarta job openings on Jobstreet in 2026), but as a conglomerate's unit it is outside the census.

rejected_record.name: GLife Technologies — Indonesian operation (PanenID)
rejected_record.why: Fails the liveness test on 18 Oct 2026. PanenID is its own Indonesian company, not just a Glife unit: Panen.ID was started in Bali in 2017 to sell smallholder farmers' produce directly to hotels, restaurants, caterers and traders, and it trades through PT Panen Indonesia Sejahtera and PT Panen Bali Sejahtera. Glife Technologies, a venture-backed Singapore food-supply company (Glife Technologies Pte Ltd), took a controlling stake in April 2022 and said it would run PanenID on its own ordering and warehouse software (Food & Beverage Asia, 12 Apr 2022; DealStreetAsia, 7 Apr 2022), so PanenID would count as a venture-bought startup in its own right. But nothing shows it trading in 2026. Its website panen.id does not answer (an empty reply over HTTP and a timeout over HTTPS, 18 Oct 2026). Its LinkedIn page (Panen Indonesia Sejahtera, 21 people, head office Jakarta, primary address Kedoya Utara, Kebon Jeruk, Jakarta Barat, read 18 Oct 2026) shows no recent posts, and no 2026 news, dated job post or other operating signal was found; its chief executive, Johannes Dwi Cahyo Kristanto, still lists the role as current on his own profile, which on its own does not show a trading business. Glife's own site (read 18 Oct 2026) describes its Singapore operation and its distribution centres in Malaysia and says nothing about Indonesia, and no other Indonesian Glife company was found; Glife's 2024 talks to buy EdenFarm came to nothing, and EdenFarm is already in the census's closed register. No source reports a closure, so PanenID is not entered in the closed register. Revisit if panen.id comes back or a 2026 operating signal appears; a row would then be PanenID itself (PT Panen Indonesia Sejahtera) with Glife as its majority owner.

rejected_record.name: ZAP Clinic (PT Zulu Alpha Papa)
rejected_record.why: Fails test 1: ZAP (PT Zulu Alpha Papa) is a founder-built and founder-funded chain of laser-based beauty, dermatology and men's grooming clinics, not a venture-built company. Fadly Sahab started it in 2009 as a home-service hair-removal business with about Rp50 million of his own savings; unable to find investors, he ran it without them and put its earnings back into the business (Fortune Indonesia 40 Under 40 profile), and in 2018 the company said it was spending nearly Rp80 billion on new laser machines (Bisnis, 15 May 2018). Its only outside shareholder on record is PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk, the listed investment company whose main shareholders are Edwin Soeryadjaya and Sandiaga Uno and whose largest holdings are stakes in Tower Bersama, Merdeka Copper Gold and Adaro. Saratoga's 2023 Annual Report says it "made a new investment in PT Zulu Alpha Papa (ZAP)", then a chain of more than 90 clinics, and counts ZAP among its "consumer-driven investments" with the motorcycle distributor MPMX and the cold-chain company MBL; its 2025 Annual Report reports on ZAP "in the consumer sector". BRI Danareksa Sekuritas research (7 Jul 2023) says Saratoga invested at the start of 2023 and holds "a significant minority ownership". The amount, the exact stake and whether Saratoga bought new or existing shares are not published. A minority stake taken by a listed investment holding in a 14-year-old, self-funded clinic chain is growth capital, not venture money that built or bought the company. Kumparan (21 Jan 2025) calls ZAP one of Saratoga's "anak usaha", but it uses the same word for Adaro, Merdeka Copper Gold and Tower Bersama, where Saratoga is also a minority holder. The clinics' technology is their booking system and client records, not a product of their own. The census counts clinic operators that venture money built or bought (Satu Dental, Filmore, KLAR Smile); LIGHThouse, a founder-built clinic chain with only debt on record, was turned down on the same ground. For the record: the business is active (new clinics at Palembang Indah Mall on 15 Jan 2026, Grand Batam Mall on 1 Sep 2026 and Depok Baru on 7 Oct 2026, per its own site; 118 clinics at December 2025, per Saratoga's 2025 Annual Report); the zapclinic.com footer names PT Zulu Alpha Papa, which is registered at Gedung Mayapada Tower 1, Jl. Jenderal Sudirman Kav. 28, Jakarta Selatan, while its head office is at The Bellezza Shopping Arcade, Permata Hijau, Kebayoran Lama, Jakarta Selatan; LinkedIn lists 1,022 people on its company page (band 1,001-5,000, read 18 Oct 2026), most of them salaried clinic staff; and Endeavor Indonesia selected its founder in June 2018. Revisit if a venture fund invests.
